spec: §15 suite A (uncall over a measure traps); §7.4: a segment containing a measure frame at any depth cannot be uncalled (FAULT_UB_TRAP)
derivation: bad_uncall calls measuring -> measurement (Bell, draw 0.1 < 1/2 selects 00) and then uncalls measuring; the segment contains a measure frame, so it traps with fault 4 after the measurement result 0 was produced.
